en.headline: Algernon Yau to lead mainland and Hong Kong firms on Malaysia visit next week
en.dek: The Commerce and Economic Development Secretary said the outbound specialist team has held more than 10 mainland promotion events and helped about 200 companies set up or expand in Hong Kong.
body: Commerce and Economic Development Secretary Algernon Yau said he would travel to Malaysia next week with mainland and Hong Kong enterprises to meet local government officials and businesses.

Speaking on a radio programme on Saturday, Yau said the outbound specialist team established last October had already organised more than 10 promotion events in places including Beijing, Shanghai and Shandong, attracting thousands of enterprises. About 200 mainland companies had set up or expanded operations in Hong Kong with a view to going global.

He outlined a three-step approach: bringing mainland firms to Hong Kong to establish companies or regional headquarters, helping them use local professional services and financing to prepare, then supporting their expansion overseas. The Chief Executive’s earlier Central Asia visit had produced 96 cooperation memoranda involving about HK$1.7 billion in investment, he added.

Yau said the aim was concrete investment outcomes and to draw enterprises from other economies to use Hong Kong as a platform into the Greater Bay Area, strengthening the city’s role as a regional supply-chain and financial centre.

zh.headline: 丘應樺下周率內地及港企訪馬來西亞
zh.dek: 商經局局長表示出海專班已在內地辦逾10場推介，約200間企業來港設立或擴展業務，準備走出去。
body: 商務及經濟發展局局長丘應樺周六在電台節目表示，下星期會聯同內地及香港企業前往馬來西亞，與當地政府及企業對接。
他指出，特區政府去年10月成立出海專班後，已在北京、上海及山東等地舉辦超過10場推廣活動，有數千間企業參與，至今約有200間內地企業在港設立或擴展業務，準備出海。
丘應樺形容企業出海須有組織，採「三部曲」：先引入內地企業來港成立公司或地區總部，利用香港法律、會計等專業服務及融資做好準備，再協助走出去。行政長官早前率團出訪中亞，已簽訂96份合作備忘錄，投資額約17億元。
他期望企業走出去能簽訂實質合作協議，並引導其他經濟體企業利用香港平台進入大灣區，強化本港作為區域供應鏈及金融中心的角色。
